# 1.37.0-beta.6

Sixth beta of 1.37.0: releases and updates.

## Smaller updates

- An update now downloads only what changed since the version you have, when the release has a patch for it, and builds the new program from your current one. Between two recent releases that is about half the size of the full file.
- The new file is installed only if it matches the release checksum, exactly as before. If the patch is missing, damaged or made for a different build, the program quietly downloads the whole file instead.
- The update question shows the size that will actually be downloaded.
- Patches start working from the next release: this beta is the first version that looks for them.

## winget

- Every release now comes with ready winget manifests. Final versions can be sent to the winget catalog automatically, so the program will be installable with `winget install Qvisono.AmarinAdminAI` once the package is accepted there. Betas are not published to winget.
- An update installed by the program itself replaces the real file when it was started through the link winget creates, not the link.
